expectations.text: Explains high-cardinality splits inflate measured information gain (spurious purity / upward bias), i.e. it is overfitting, not real signal.
expectations.evidence: States upward bias is (K_X−1)(K_Y−1)/(2N); for customer_id K_X ≈ N so bias ≈ (K_Y−1)/2 — a fixed large offset unrelated to signal. Pure leaves are mechanical.
